input.title: Space is not automatically inserted between emoji and colored text
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

1. Create thought `Hello`.
2. Set the color to red.
3. Set the caret at the beginning and insert an emoji, 👋.

## Current Behavior

The emoji is inserted but no space is added after it.

```
👋Hello
```

## Expected Behavior

Space should be immediately inserted between emoji and text, per #4139.

```
👋 Hello
```
